text: Visa Inc. is listed on the NYSE (ticker V); per its December 2025 proxy statement, its largest disclosed shareholders are The Vanguard Group (8.18%) and BlackRock Inc. (7.32%), among 311 shareholders of record. No state or sovereign-fund holder is listed among them.

source.name: Visa Inc., 2025 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A)
source.quote: those persons known to the Company to be the beneficial owners of more than 5% of the Company's Class A common stock
